原: …an account that you don’t expect to log into very often, the researchers advise websites to include more of an incentive…
疑为: …very often. The researchers advise websites to include more of an incentive…
理由: 两句被逗号连成一句（研究结论与研究人员的建议是两件事），翻译按两句译
短文第102句说的是 Slimmeretics，念题时转写成 Slimmer Redix，是同一款应用，翻译统一为 Slimmeretics（第122句同）

原: …and respecting the property of others. / Oxford University has concluded.
疑为: …and respecting the property of others, Oxford University has concluded.
理由: 第130句是第129句的句尾转述语，被句号切开，翻译分两段按一句的意思译

原: Although many cultures are moving towards more liberal, less hierarchical. / Organizations. / The new research suggests…

理由: 第131—133句本是一句，被句号从 hierarchical 和 organizations 处切断，翻译按一句的意思分段译

原: Everyone, everywhere, shares a common moral code,” said Dr. Oliver Scott Curry…

原: …collected between 2013 and 2015, well-being was tracked using measures of positive affect. / Whether during the day, before they were surveyed, participants had smiled…
疑为: …collected between 2013 and 2015. Well-being was tracked using measures of positive affect: whether during the day before they were surveyed participants had smiled…
理由: 第187句两句被逗号连起，第188句是说明 positive affect 测量内容的从句、被句号切成独立一句，翻译按“也就是看……”接上
与第185句拼写不一致，是同一人，译名统一为里娅·卡塔帕诺（第205句同）
